predecessors.name: British Africa (remaining colonies)
predecessors.text: the Gambia Colony and Protectorate: 'the British colonial administration of The Gambia from 1821 to 1965'

ledger.x: 18 February 1965: the Gambia becomes independent from the United Kingdom as a constitutional monarchy.
24 April 1970: the Gambia becomes a republic within the Commonwealth.

wars.name: 1981 Gambian coup attempt and Senegalese intervention
wars.outcome: 'President Jawara requested military aid from Senegal, which deployed 400 troops to The Gambia on 31 July.'

certainty.note: 'The present boundaries were defined in 1889 after an agreement between the United Kingdom and France'; the colony page: 'France and Britain agreed in 1889 in principle to set the boundary at 10 km (6.2 miles) north and south of the river'…
